turns.question: List the names of the tracks on the album 'Let There Be Rock'.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT t.name FROM track t JOIN album a ON a.album_id = t.album_id WHERE a.title = 'Let There Be Rock'
turns.sql:
SELECT t.name 
FROM track t
JOIN album a ON t.album_id = a.album_id
WHERE a.title = 'Let There Be Rock'
turns.answer:
The names of the tracks on the album 'Let There Be Rock' are:
- Let There Be Rock
- Go Down
- Dog Eat Dog

turns.question: Which 5 genres have the most tracks? Show the genre name and the number of tracks, most first.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT g.name, count(*) AS tracks FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name ORDER BY tracks DESC LIMIT 5
turns.sql:
SELECT g.name AS genre_name, COUNT(*) AS track_count
FROM genre g
JOIN track t ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id
GROUP BY g.name
ORDER BY track_count DESC
LIMIT 5
turns.answer: Rock has 1297 tracks, Latin has 579 tracks, Metal has 374 tracks, Alternative & Punk has 332 tracks, and Jazz has 130 tracks.

turns.question: Show the same, but count the tracks sold instead.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT g.name, sum(il.quantity) AS sold FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT 5
turns.sql:
SELECT g.name AS genre_name, COUNT(*) AS track_count
FROM genre g
JOIN track t ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id
JOIN invoice_line il ON t.track_id = il.track_id
GROUP BY g.name
ORDER BY track_count DESC
LIMIT 5
turns.answer: The top 5 genres by tracks sold are: Rock with 835 tracks, Latin with 386 tracks, Metal with 264 tracks, Alternative & Punk with 244 tracks, and Jazz with 80 tracks.

turns.question: How many customers does each sales support agent look after? Show the agent's first and last name and the number of customers.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, count(*) AS customers FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
turns.sql:

turns.question: How many invoices were there in 2022?

turns.answer: There were 83 invoices in 2022 as per the SQL query result.

turns.question: How much revenue did they bring in?

turns.answer: The total revenue brought in is $2328.60.

turns.question: And in 2023?

turns.question: What was the total revenue in each year? Show the year and the revenue.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT extract(year FROM invoice_date) AS year, sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice GROUP BY 1
turns.sql:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) AS year,
    SUM(unit_price * quantity) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    invoice_line
JOIN 
    invoice ON invoice_line.invoice_id = invoice.invoice_id
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)
ORDER BY 
    year;
turns.answer:
The total revenue in each year is as follows: 
2021 had a total revenue of $449.46, 
2022 had a total revenue of $481.45, 
2023 had a total revenue of $469.58, 
2024 had a total revenue of $477.53, 
2025 had a total revenue of $450.58.

turns.question: Which employees are sales support agents? Give their first and last names.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employee WHERE title = 'Sales Support Agent'
turns.sql:
SELECT first_name, last_name
FROM employee
WHERE first_name LIKE '%Sales%'
  AND first_name != 'Sales'
  AND last_name != 'Sales'
  AND reports_to IS NULL;

turns.question: How much revenue did each of them bring in through their customers? Show the name and the revenue.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, sum(i.total) AS revenue FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE e.title = 'Sales Support Agent' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
turns.sql:
SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM employee e
JOIN customer c ON e.employee_id = c.support_rep_id
JOIN invoice i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
JOIN invoice_line il ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id
JOIN employee e2 ON e2.employee_id = c.support_rep_id
WHERE e.first_name LIKE '%Sales%'
  AND e.first_name != 'Sales'
  AND e.last_name != 'Sales'
  AND e2.reports_to IS NULL
GROUP BY e.first_name, e.last_name;

turns.question: Which of them brought in the most?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE e.title = 'Sales Support Agent' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY sum(i.total) DESC LIMIT 1
turns.sql:
SELECT e2.first_name, e2.last_name, SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM employee e
JOIN customer c ON e.employee_id = c.support_rep_id
JOIN invoice i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
JOIN invoice_line il ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id
JOIN employee e2 ON e2.employee_id = c.support_rep_id
WHERE e2.first_name LIKE '%Sales%'
  AND e2.first_name != 'Sales'
  AND e2.last_name != 'Sales'
  AND e2.reports_to IS NULL
GROUP BY e2.first_name, e2.last_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

turns.question: Which billing country has the highest average invoice total?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT billing_country FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY avg(total) DESC LIMIT 1
turns.sql:
SELECT billing_country, AVG(total) as avg_total
FROM invoice
GROUP BY billing_country
ORDER BY avg_total DESC
LIMIT 1;
turns.answer: The billing country with the highest average invoice total is Chile with an average total of 6.66.

turns.question: Which artist has sold the most tracks?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT r.name FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN album a ON a.album_id = t.album_id JOIN artist r ON r.artist_id = a.artist_id GROUP BY r.artist_id, r.name ORDER BY sum(il.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
turns.sql:
SELECT a.artist_id, a.name, SUM(il.quantity) AS total_tracks_sold
FROM artist a
JOIN album al ON a.artist_id = al.artist_id
JOIN track t ON al.album_id = t.album_id
JOIN invoice_line il ON t.track_id = il.track_id
GROUP BY a.artist_id, a.name
ORDER BY total_tracks_sold DESC
LIMIT 1;
turns.answer: Iron Maiden has sold 140 tracks, which is the highest number among the given data.

turns.sql:
